questions.passage: Nathan boarded the train on Saturday evening. As he made his way to his seat, he found someone already sitting there. Confused, he checked his ticket and realized his mistake — it was for Sunday, not Saturday! A flush of panic spread across his face. He quickly approached a train attendant and explained the situation. 'Is there anything I can do to resolve this?' Nathan asked. 'Don't worry, sir. We still have seats available,' the attendant said with a reassuring smile. Nathan exchanged his old ticket for a new one, his worries melting away. Settling into his seat, he let out a deep breath, feeling __________ ease as the train began to move.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기차가 움직이기 시작하자 어깨의 긴장(the tension in his shoulders)이 풀리는 것을 느꼈다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a flush of panic(당황의 홍조): 'ease'와 문법적으로 어색하며 이미 해소된 감정
❌ ② his worries melting away(걱정이 녹아내리는): 이미 앞 문장에서 사용된 표현, 중복
✅ ③ the tension in his shoulders(어깨의 긴장): 원문과 일치, 'ease'와 자연스럽게 연결 ←정답
❌ ④ a reassuring smile(안심시키는 미소): 승무원의 미소이며 Nathan이 느끼는 것이 아님
det.tip: tension in one's shoulders: 스트레스로 인한 어깨 긴장. ease와 함께 '풀리다' 표현
